prompt: A popular skill overlaps an installed harness skill and requests a new global CLI. Decide whether to recommend or skip it.
Improve a dense CRM dashboard using its current Tailwind tokens and brand assets; preserve accessibility and avoid a framework rewrite.
The implementation plan is approved, but one ambiguous rollback choice remains. Ask only what changes execution, then hand off the next slice.
Use an existing logged-in Chrome session to inspect a form, but stop safely if the current URL cannot be verified.
A Next.js route mixes request-specific state with module state and serializes an oversized object to a client component. Review it without adding packages.
A rejected architecture option has an enduring constraint, while a chosen color preference is reversible. Decide what belongs in ADRs or glossary.
Recent commits touch five adapters. Determine whether consolidation is justified and distinguish confirmed findings from speculative risk.
A duplicate-submit bug is reported in one UI, but all callers share one command handler. Choose the test seam and smallest root fix.
Review an icon toolbar that passes route smoke tests but has unclear focus, error, and busy states in two themes.
Resolve context for a repository with two hosted-agent services and conflicting azd and metadata project endpoints before any deployment.
